episodes.211438: A few widely scattered thunderstorms produced localized gale-force winds associated with an upper-level low during the morning to midday hours.
episodes.212706: Well above normal March to mid-April rainfall upstream along the Ohio River from East-Central Missouri and Central Illinois to Iowa/Wisconsin resulted in river levels briefly rising into minor flood at Chester mid-month. Impacts were limited to bottomland agricultural areas.
episodes.213061: Persistent isentropic lift generated showers and thunderstorms that led to excessive rainfall and flash flooding.
